title: Anti-COVID-measures demonstration in Luxembourg City
location: Between Glacis and Place Guillaume II, Luxembourg City
scope: One reported public demonstration with speeches and an open microphone; no location/day split.
organizer: Promoted on social networks; named organizer not reported.
participants_original: RTL Today’s same article estimates around 200 in its English text and says “several dozen” in its embedded French text; no numeric range is inferred.
threshold_50_evidence: The English estimate is above 50, but the same page’s French description is materially lower/ambiguous. No reconciled crowd estimate; threshold remains pending.

start_date.summary: RTL report dated Jan 9 and identifies the Saturday demonstration.

location.summary: Between Glacis and Place Guillaume II.

demands.summary: Opposition to government COVID measures, masking, mass testing, restrictions and vaccination; 5G also mentioned.

organizer.summary: The event was promoted on social networks; no named organizer.

participants_original.summary: Same article has the conflicting English around-200 estimate and French several-dozen description.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Contradictory within-page crowd descriptions prevent settled threshold coding.

notes: RTL reports about 15 police present but no event-specific action; response fields remain unknown. The same article mentions an earlier municipal-park protest of around 40 but gives no date; it is not assigned to this event or January.
open_questions: Reconcile the English and embedded French attendance descriptions.
Identify the date and source for the earlier municipal-park gathering.

title: HORECA owners’ protest against continued closures
scope: A distinct HORECA action reported separately from the nearby anti-measures gathering; press also describes a silent march.
organizer: Café and restaurant owners, coordinated via social media; named café owner Cristina Borges helped organize.
participants_original: Le Quotidien reports about 200 restaurant/café owners; RTL confirms the event but gives no count.
threshold_50_evidence: The opened contemporary Le Quotidien account reports about 200 participants, supporting a provisional 50+ threshold.

start_date.summary: RTL reports the Saturday gathering; Le Quotidien dated Jan 18 refers to the preceding Saturday, Jan 16.

location.summary: RTL identifies Place d’Armes; Le Quotidien describes the separate city-centre group.

scope.summary: Le Quotidien distinguishes the HORECA action from a separate anti-measures group.

organizer.summary: The protest was organized through social media; Cristina Borges says she helped organize it.

demands.summary: Protest over prolonged closure and lack of adequate support; Le Quotidien reports concern about business failure.

participants_original.summary: Le Quotidien reports about 200 HORECA participants; RTL does not give attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Opened article reports around 200 for this HORECA group, distinct from the smaller anti-measures group.

notes: The planned Jan16 rally by a different organizer was canceled; this candidate is the separate Place d’Armes action that contemporary coverage confirms took place. The minister’s general comments in RTL are not coded as an event-specific response.
open_questions: Check whether Le Quotidien’s count derives from independent reporting; exact ending time is unknown.

title: Anti-measures / anti-mask gathering at Knuedler
location: Knuedler, Luxembourg City (press reporting); the judicial case narrative also gives a city-centre procession route but has an unresolved date conflict.
scope: Reported as the separate anti-mask/vaccine group alongside the HORECA march. Possible link to the Jan16 judicially cited procession remains unresolved.
organizer: Activists called the gathering through social networks; no named organizer in contemporary press.
participants_original: Contemporary reports describe a few dozen / several dozen; the judgment contains a Jan16 charge in the 4–10 legal bracket, but under the same case heading later describes a March 3 assembly with about 50 then 120. No crowd number is assigned.
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporary descriptions suggest a group below 50 but are qualitative; the legal bracket and same-case date inconsistency do not resolve actual attendance for this event.

start_date.summary: Contemporary Jan16 reports identify the gathering; the judgment’s section alleges Jan16 conduct but its following body under the same case heading describes a March 3 meeting.

location.summary: Contemporary press places anti-measures demonstrators at Knuedler; the judgment also lists a city-centre route under the conflicting case narrative.

demands.summary: Opposition to masks, vaccination, mass testing and COVID restrictions.

organizer.summary: Search-result excerpt says activists had called via social networks; names not supplied.

participants_original.summary: Press uses a few/several-dozen description; the judgment’s legal category is not a crowd count and its same-case March 3 passage cannot be transferred.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Size likely below 50 by contemporary descriptions, but date/event compatibility and legal category leave threshold evidence unresolved.

notes: This nomination is retained for review, not treated as a proven 50+ event. Sources S016 and S018 are excerpt-only; S021 was read in full by the coordinator. Same-case Jan16 vs March3 chronology remains unresolved; do not transfer March3 attendance.
open_questions: Resolve whether the Jan16 charges in the judgment refer to this Knuedler gathering and how to read the March3 narrative under the same case heading.
Verify exact turnout; current contemporary descriptions suggest few dozen.

title: HORECA procession in Ville-Haute
location: Ville-Haute, Luxembourg City; exact sites are anonymized in the judgment.
scope: One HORECA-support procession, distinct from a concurrent P1 anti-measures gathering; not merged with Jan16 or Jan30.
organizer: HORECA procession; a Land search-result excerpt names Clément Elie as initiator.
participants_original: d’Lëtzebuerger Land search excerpt reports about 200 demonstrators; official judgment confirms a separate HORECA-support manifestation but does not provide a count.
threshold_50_evidence: The roughly 200 estimate is only in an unread search-result excerpt; retain as provisional pending fuller review.

start_date.summary: Official court judgment identifies a Jan23 event; Land’s Jan29 excerpt refers to the preceding Saturday.

location.summary: The judgment locates two distinct Jan23 demonstrations in Ville-Haute; anonymized addresses prevent exact route recovery.

scope.summary: Court identifies one event in support of HORECA and a separate P1 event; Land excerpt describes the HORECA procession.

organizer.summary: Land search excerpt identifies Clément Elie as march initiator; not confirmed from full article.

demands.summary: Event was in support of HORECA during government-mandated closure; specific public demand needs fuller reporting.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: About 200 would exceed threshold if the excerpt is confirmed; source remains search-only.

notes: The two notices for the P1 gathering are treated as evidence about one Jan23 event, not as two events. The legal 11–100 category for P1 does not apply to this separate HORECA procession.
open_questions: Read the Land page and verify the crowd estimate, organizer, route, demand and source overlap.

title: P1-organized anti-measures gathering in Ville-Haute
location: Ville-Haute, Luxembourg City; exact addresses anonymized in the judgment.
scope: One P1-organized gathering, distinct from a simultaneous HORECA-support procession. Two police notices refer to the same gathering and are not split into two events.
organizer: P1, anonymized in the court record.
participants_original: The prosecution’s legal category is 11–100 persons; this is a statutory bracket, not an observed estimate, and it spans both sides of 50. No count or bounds assigned.
threshold_50_evidence: Court’s 11–100 bracket does not establish that at least 50 attended; threshold remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: Two police notices identify conduct at the gathering on Jan23.

location.summary: The court identifies the neighborhood as Ville-Haute but redacts exact addresses.

scope.summary: Court expressly distinguishes the P1 gathering from the concurrent HORECA-support gathering.

organizer.summary: Court identifies the organizer as anonymized P1.

demands.summary: P2 told police the health measures were contrary to human rights and illegal; public wording at the gathering is not documented.

participants_original.summary: The allegation invokes a statutory 11–100 category; it is not a headcount.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: 11–100 spans below and above 50; do not code it as >=50.

notes: The later police interview statement is evidence of opposition to restrictions but not a verified statement made at the public gathering. All seven state-response fields and protester violence remain unknown.
open_questions: Verify actual attendance and event-time demand; obtain non-anonymized location only from an authorized public record.

title: HORECA procession demanding reopening of restaurants and bars
location: Procession from Place Guillaume II to the Chamber of Deputies, Luxembourg City.
scope: One Jan30 procession; kept distinct from earlier HORECA gatherings and not treated as a campaign-day.
organizer: HORECA protest organizers; individuals are not named in the opened report.
participants_original: RTL reports organizers expected 150 and said attendance exceeded that by 200 (reported total 350); this is organizer-reported, not independently counted.
threshold_50_evidence: Organizer-reported total is clearly over 50; one opened report supports provisional inclusion.

start_date.summary: Opened report describes the protest on Jan30.

location.summary: Opened report gives route from Place Guillaume II to the Chamber of Deputies.

demands.summary: Protest called for restaurants/bars to reopen and an economic perspective for the sector.

organizer.summary: Article attributes the turnout estimate and action to organizers, without naming them.

participants_original.summary: Organizers said expected 150 was exceeded by 200; RTL rendered the estimate as 350.

notes: RTL calls this the third HORECA protest in the capital. The article does not identify all prior dates or report an event end or event-specific state response.
open_questions: Seek an independent attendance estimate and more exact event end/response evidence.
